title: Design Engineer, Energy, Service Efficiency
description:
**What to Expect**

The Service TPT (Tooling Process Training) Engineering team is responsible for design-to-production of custom service and commissioning tooling and sustaining solutions for Tesla Energy storage and charging. This role owns the specification, design prioritization, field sustainment, and release readiness of the hardware used by Energy Service technicians. This person keeps those hours in field optimized via owning field failures, technician feedback, and reman findings into a ranked spec and a field process — hardware that is comfortable, serviceable on the ground, and ready to build more of. We are looking for someone with enthusiasm for where innovation meets energy storage.

  
**What You'll Do**

* **Field gear specifications and design prioritization:** Own the technical specification and the priority stack for the body-worn data-collection system and its sub-assemblies: Examples of hardware to spec and test; harness definition (connector pinout, shielding, strain relief, bend radius, length, bundling), power interface (battery mount, fuse protection, cross-platform compatibility), and sensor-chain integrity (camera, IMU, tactile, current sense). Turn the issue log, end-of-shift technician feedback, and reman teardowns into a ranked roadmap — failure mode, subsystem, and blocked collection hours — that ME and EE execute. Handshake electrical, mechanical, and firmware changes
* **Field representation:** Be the engineering interface to technicians, hub teams, and reman. Read how the tools are actually used and how it fails across a service day: cable pinch and snag, connector back-out, camera and IMU dropouts, battery sag, and hard-hat, eyewear, and headset interference. Use that evidence to keep revision scope tied to the physics and the repeat rate, stop one-off fixes from accumulating on the fleet
* **Ground-level sustainment:** Own the service specification and the documents that let the field repair tooling hardware instead of shipping it
